title: Build owner visit calendar and group detail
requirements: Turn the existing owner navigation into hash-based inquiries/calendar views without weakening session bootstrap, runtime-only CSRF, credentials include, logout, inquiry filters, pagination or detail behavior.

For the calendar, load club_timezone from GET /api/v1/public/catalog and never substitute the developer computer timezone. If a valid IANA timezone cannot be obtained, show a safe explicit unavailable state instead of querying an invented interval.

Render a responsive Russian month calendar with previous, next and current-month controls. Form UTC from-inclusive/to-exclusive month bounds from the club timezone, request GET /api/v1/admin/visits with limit 100, follow every opaque next_cursor page for the same interval and preserve server ordering.

Show every returned visit in its club-local day cell without a hidden per-day limit. Each card exposes only accepted VisitSummary fields and clearly marks unresolved inquiries; loading, empty, range, authorization, server and network states must be safe and accessible.

Open GET /api/v1/admin/visits/{id} from a calendar card and render the accepted plan plus every current participation with requester name, inquiry status, participants and cash summary. Return to the same month; do not add write commands or infer missing end times, money or eligibility.

Add dependency-free structural tests under tests/web004 and run the existing owner session/inquiry contract tests. Do not add backend changes, external libraries, tracking, credentials, hosting or network tests.
acceptance: The owner can switch between inquiries and a large-cell monthly calendar, navigate months, see all visits including busy days and open a group detail without losing the selected month.
Calendar API intervals use the configured club timezone and all cursor pages; missing timezone and API failures remain explicit rather than showing misleading empty data.
WEB-002A, WEB-003 and WEB-004 offline tests, JavaScript syntax, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted read-only owner calendar UI over the existing authenticated visit and public timezone contracts.
